name: AUS3 Internet
summary: Brisbane dialup + hosting + eCommerce ISP (formerly Ozlinx Internet); ISP gone by 2002, aus3.com pivoted to a marketing agency.

events.details: 56k dialup + web hosting + eCommerce; Brisbane (GPO Box 788, ph 07 3841 4888); formerly Ozlinx Internet.

ISP still operating Sep 2001 (Cynosure directory, aus3.com internet access + hosting); by May 2002 aus3.com had pivoted to a marketing/branding agency, referring visitors elsewhere for a 'low-cost ISP'.
